in_marathi.name: Shrishail
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrishail हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shrishail is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Shri' meaning 'Lord' and 'Shail' meaning 'Mountain'. Hence, the name Shrishail means 'Lord of the Mountains'.
